top_signals.title: Lockheed Martin Europe Chief Executive on Rheinmetall & Transatlantic Deterrence
top_signals.summary:
The European chief executive of US defense company Lockheed Martin said transatlantic partnerships such as the one with Rheinmetall will build a credible deterrence and economic benefits on both sides. Dennis Goege spoke with Bloomberg’s Lizzy Burden from Frankfurt.

Corrects guest's title. (Source: Bloomberg)
